title: The application of large language models in medicine: A scoping review

sections.text:
《The application of large language models in medicine: A scoping review》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】This study systematically reviewed the application of large language models (LLMs) in medicine, analyzing 550 selected studies from a vast literature search.
